name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Resolution on the democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Georgia. It condemns new Georgian laws on "foreign influence" and "family values", and changes to election rules. It says these laws limit free speech, target civil society and discriminate against people. It asks the European Union to freeze funding to Georgia's government until these laws are repealed, and to sanction people blamed for undermining democracy.

- The European Union should freeze funding to Georgia's government until the laws are repealed.
- The European Union should sanction officials blamed for undermining democracy, including Bidzina Ivanishvili.
- Georgia's parliamentary elections on 26 October 2024 should be free and fair.
